The '''lyaer'tsa''' was a traditional [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] weapon used on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] in ceremonial contests. It consisted of a staff containing a [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]] on one end, which was used in armed combat. As part of tradition, this weapon was designed only to inflict injury and not to kill a person. [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], [[Winter Celchu|Winter]], [[Sixtus Quin]], and [[Septaas]] wielded these weapons in a contest arranged by [[Cazne'olan]] for custody of [[Firith Olan]].
